messages:
elena_cs: FYI Cedar renewal — they want upfront invoice (full term) + Net45. Also asking for customer-managed keys for EU-only data. Need quick alignment on pricing and sign flow.

lucy_ae: AE says customer will sign if we can do upfront and offer 7% early-pay. They can provide PO same day.

ryan_fin: Finance can process upfront invoice with Net45 if we get PO and sales approval for the 7% discount. Need billing entity + tax id.

dana_legal: CMK (customer-managed keys) for EU is Private-only. We can add data residency clause for hosted but cannot promise CMK. Will draft simple addendum: "Customer data originating in EU will be stored in EU regions."

owen_ops: Confirmed: hosted EU region keeps embeddings/logs in EU, but CMK/HSM requires Private deployment and ~4-6 week lead time.

elena_cs: AE to confirm whether they accept hosted + residency clause or need Private. Lucy please confirm with Cedar.

lucy_ae: Pinged Cedar. They prefer hosted if residency clause + SOC2 reference OK. Asking for PO now.

ryan_fin: Once PO arrives, I'll queue invoice with 7% discount and Net45. Tag me with PO#.

dana_legal: I'll prepare the redline addendum referencing SOC2 and EU storage. Posting later today.

elena_cs: Goal: signed SOW + PO by Friday COB. Will update thread with any blocker. :v:
